json.task: Plan, track, and report on client projects.
benefits: Provides community and help for starting teams
Offers a centralized platform for planning, tracking, and reporting on client projects
Enables a unified view of project progress, workload, and time tracking
Facilitates faster status reporting and earlier risk identification
frictions: Lacks the ability to set different work schedules per team or person
Inaccurate tracking due to a single work schedule for teams spanning different weekend cultures
